_comment: The only file you edit to change what the monitor watches. Add a group by pasting its URL into the right region. No script or plist changes needed, and no reload — each scheduled run reads this file fresh. ⚠️ MEMBERSHIP IS NOT ALWAYS REQUIRED, which an earlier version of this note got wrong. A PUBLIC group is readable by a signed-in non-member: six Italian groups were added on 2026-10-11 without joining any of them, after Facebook started refusing joins. A PRIVATE or restricted group does need membership — the three flagged in the 2026-10-08 audit (RevelstokeCashJobs, 889986741929213, 1378531332445868) were re-tested the same day and are still unreadable. ⚠️ AND A SINGLE 'WARNING: 0 posts' PROVES NOTHING: lavorodolomiti returned 5 posts, then 0 twice, then 1 — it is readable and merely flaky. Re-test before concluding a group is dead. The one check that matters, before adding anything here: npm run fb:collect -- --group <url> --posts 5 — a group name and a post count means usable; 'WARNING: 0 posts' means try again, and if it stays dead, join it or drop it. ITALY: the prefilter carries Italian keywords (added 2026-10-11, drops 31% against English's 16%) and the local triage model is OFF for this region in install.ts — it is a 7B measured only on English, and anything it drops is dropped silently. Italy therefore pays full extraction per post until its loss rate is measured.
